id: \bTate: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bTate: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \bTell: Ti servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \bDon't expect us\n\rto go easy on you.
en: \bDon't expect us\n\rto go easy on you.
it: \bNon aspettarti che ci\n\randiamo piano con te.

id: \bTate: It does physical damage but damages with special power.
en: \bTate: It does physical damage but damages with special power.
it: \bTell: Infligge danni fisici, ma sfrutta la potenza speciale.

id: \bTate: Be sure to visit the Space Center.
en: \bTate: Be sure to visit the Space Center.
it: \bTell: Non dimenticare di visitare il Centro Spaziale.

id: \rLiza: The place is a lot of fun.
en: \rLiza: The place is a lot of fun.

id: \rLiza: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rLiza: You'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rPat: Ti servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \bI don't suppose you're here by accident.
en: \bI don't suppose you're here by accident.
it: \bNon credo che tu sia qui per caso.

id: \rI knew I would lose, but it still sucks.
en: \rI knew I would lose, but it still sucks.
it: \rSapevo che avrei perso, ma rode lo stesso.

id: \bTate & Liza use Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
en: \bTate & Liza use Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
it: \bTell e Pat usano Pokémon di tipo Psico. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Spettro e Buio.

id: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison. Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison.  Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Lotta e Veleno.  Anche le mosse Psico e Lotta non fanno loro molto danno.
